scripts.build: npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/shared-types && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/spotify-auth && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/configurator && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/cloudflare-worker
scripts.test:wasm-parity: node scripts/require-wasm-artifacts.mjs && npm run test -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper -- src/wasm/wasmParity.test.ts
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:preview: npm run migrate:primary:preview -w @spotify-wallpaper/cloudflare-worker && npm run migrate:deletion:preview -w @spotify-wallpaper/cloudflare-worker
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:production: npm run migrate:primary:production -w @spotify-wallpaper/cloudflare-worker && npm run migrate:deletion:production -w @spotify-wallpaper/cloudflare-worker
scripts.scan:public-backend-secrets:all: node scripts/check-public-backend-secrets.mjs apps/wallpaper/dist apps/cloudflare-worker/dist apps/cloudflare-worker/dist-preview apps/cloudflare-worker/dist-production
scripts.verify:repository-authority: npm run test:repository-authority && npm run check:repository-authority && npm run check:repository-preservation
scripts.check: npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/shared-types && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper-view && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/spotify-auth && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/configurator && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/cloudflare-worker
scripts.test: npm run test:repository-authority && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
